newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hochtief sees good chance in airport bid.
newsitem.headline: Hochtief sees good chance in airport bid.

text.p: German construction group Hochtief said on Thursday that it expected to be among a small group of candidates with a chance to buy a 50 percent stake in Duesseldorf airport.

"We are assuming, that Hochtief will be the only firm from North Rhine-Westphalia with experience in international airports to be able to work out a binding offer," Hochtief Chief Executive Hans-Peter Keitel said in the text of a speech for delivery at the firm's general meeting.
North Rhine-Westphalia is the central German state in which the airport is located.
Eight bids have currently been made to buy a 50 percent stake in the airport for the 50 percent. The offers are scheduled to be narrowed down to just two or three by the beginning of July.
The remaining 50 percent of the airport is held by the city of Duesseldorf.
